modules.name: Android widgets
modules.description: Adds Android widget support to the home screen.
modules.usage: Install it, then on the home screen tap Add widget and pick a widget. Long-press a widget to remove it.

modules.name: Popup apps and dock
modules.description: Apps open in popup view with an OSX-style dock for app switching.
modules.usage: Install it and a dock appears at the bottom of the screen. Tap an icon to open or minimize the app; long-press to close it. Apps opened from the dock appear in a popup window.
